name: Student
feature: School/University Library or Archive Access - Add 1 die to Action Rolls that involve research while in library.
ability: Quick Learner – May reroll a failed Intelligence check once per session.
rivals: Competitive Classmate, Disapproving Academic, School Bully

name: Artist
feature: Personal Studio/Workspace - Add a Tier die bonus to rolls that involve a creative or artistic solution while in this space.
ability: Inspired – Add 1 die bonus to next roll after coming up with a creative solution a once per session.
rivals: Art Critic, Jealous Peer, Art Thief

name: Criminal
feature: Black Market Fence - Add Tier bonus in acquiring or selling items in a black market setting, by getting better rates or having an easier time obtaining black market items.
ability: Silent as a Shadow – Reroll a check involving criminal activity when under the cover of darkness or dim light once per session.

name: Mechanic
feature: Garage and Tool Kit - Add Tier bonus to repair or crafting made in the location.
ability: Quick Fix – Immediately repair a mechanical item that will function for the next hour. Usable once per session.
allies: Car Dealer, Loyal Customer, Parts Supplier
rivals: Rival Mechanic, Unhappy Customer, Shady Business Partner

name: Athlete
feature: Sports Equipment/Training Facilities - Add 1 Advance to a number of sessions equal to your Tier bonus after making use of this equipment/facilities.
ability: Competitive Edge: Halve the difficulty of a Strength or Dexterity based task once per session.
rivals: Rival Athlete/Team, Unscrupulous Agent, Disgruntled Fan

name: Bartender
feature: Work the Crowd - When you are in an area with a large crowd such as a bar, club, or coffee shop, you add your Tier bonus to rolls to persuade or deal with those present.
ability: Good Listener – Gain insight or rumors from people. Half the difficulty of Awareness rolls listening to people or reading individuals once per session.
rivals: Disgruntled Customer, Local Drunk, City Official

name: Hacker
feature: Advanced Computer Setup - Add Tier bonus when having access to this specialized equipment.
ability: Digital Ghost – Once per session, can erase digital traces, make online searches untraceable, or hack without leaving evidence by halving the difficulty of the task.
allies: Online Friend, Info Broker, Tech Vendor
rivals: Corporate Security Expert, Rival Hacker, Law Enforcement

name: Firefighter
feature: Firetruck/Ambulance - Use of this vehicle and the access it provides. Add 1 Advance to any driving or access roll that using such a vehicle would benefit the scenario.
ability: Once per session, gain Damage Reduction to Fire damage equal to Tier level for an encounter.
allies: Firehouse Team, Emergency Services, Victims Saved

name: Police Officer
feature: Criminal Database - Access to Law Enforcement database to check criminal records and background checks. Add 1 Advance to any task that would make use of such a database.
ability: Flash the Badge – Intimidate or persuade civilian cooperation more easily by showing badge/ID. Add Tier bonus to when making rolls that involve show credentials once per session.

name: Social Media Influencer
feature: Significant Online Following - Add Tier bonus to tasks and social situations where having a number of social follower could impact the outcome.
ability: Trendsetter – Once per session, influence a social situation or public opinion significantly, reducing the difficulty of related social tasks by half.
rivals: Internet Troll, Rival Influencer, Exposed Scammer

name: Boxer
feature: Access to Fighting Gym and Equipment - Add +1 die bonus to Fortitude and unarmed physical attacks for days equal to your Tier bonus after making use of this equipment/facilities.
ability: Fighter's Instinct – Gain + 1 Evasion bonus to attacks or other dangers that cause damage once per session (lasts 1 Minute).
rivals: Rival Boxer, Corrupt Promoter, Disapproving Family Member

name: Marksman
feature: Access to Shooting Range/Equipment - Add +1 die bonus to Composure and rolls dealing with a weapon proficient with for days equal to your Tier bonus after making use of this equipment/facilities.
ability: Deadshot – Reroll a failed roll when using a ranged weapon once per session.
allies: Shooting Range Owner, Gun Shop Owner, Hunting Buddy
rivals: Competitive Shooter, Skeptical Law Enforcement, Anti-gun Activist

name: Medic
feature: Ambulance - Use of this vehicle and the access it provides. Add 1 Success to any driving or access roll that using such a vehicle would benefit the scenario.
ability: Healing Hands – Once per session, the effect of medicine or other healing is doubly effective.
allies: Medical Professionals, Emergency Services, Victims Saved

name: Taxi Driver
feature: Business Vehicle - Add Tier bonus of a task that having a business vehicle could impact the outcome.
ability: Shortcut Knowledge – Reduce the difficulty of navigating an city/area that is familiar with by half once per session.
rivals: Competitive Driver, Unhappy Customer, Traffic Cop
